title: Licensure; fees.
bodyText:
[Section effective until June 30, 2026. For section effective July 1, 2026, see below.] A license shall be issued to a person deemed to be qualified under section 453D-7 upon the payment of a license fee to be determined by the department and shall be valid for three years. [L 2004, c 209, pt of §2; am L 2008, c 206, §1]

§453D-10 Licensure; fees. [Section effective July 1, 2026. For section effective until June 30, 2026, see above.] A license shall be issued to a person deemed to be qualified under sections 453D-7.5 or 453D-7 upon the payment of a license fee to be determined by the department and shall be valid for three years; provided that provisional licenses shall be valid for one year.
